## New
- Listen brings Radio, Books, Podcasts and named personal mixes together.
- Listen to Radio Haanji, SBS, ABC Melbourne and 3AW, with station favourites and official Victoria emergency-information links.
- Import DRM-free audiobooks, save listening bookmarks, search YouTube books and podcasts, and subscribe to HTTPS audio RSS feeds.
- Browse radio, books and podcasts from Android Auto.

## Improved
- Downloaded-only playback prevents online audio requests and offers local search.
- Punjabi searches support Gurmukhi transliteration and common English spelling variants.
- Optional Smart Download rotation protects manual, liked, playlist and currently playing files.
- Dislike offers a brief undo window before downloaded audio is removed.
- Reach playlist backup and restore directly from Listen.
